# awscc_iot_thing_principal_attachment (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::IoT::ThingPrincipalAttachment



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal` (String) The principal, which can be a certificate ARN (as returned from the CreateCertificate operation) or an Amazon Cognito ID.
- `thing_name` (String) The name of the AWS IoT thing.

### Optional

- `thing_principal_type` (String) The type of the relation you want to specify when you attach a principal to a thing.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iot_thing_principal_attachment.example
  identity = {
    thing_name = "thing_name"
    principal  = "principal"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `principal` (String) The principal, which can be a certificate ARN (as returned from the CreateCertificate operation) or an Amazon Cognito ID

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iot_thing_principal_attachment.example
  id = "thing_name|principal"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
